Tac, saw Alogent earned Federal Reserve authorization to exchange X9 check image files directly, plus those 2026 PayTech award nods.

I built a personalized signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alogent needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new Fed connectivity is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a banking-software motion? I'll tailor it to Alogent either way.
